entities.name: bL12 ribosomal protein
observations: The 122-aa query exactly matches curated Neisseria bL12 reference sequences over full length; annotated as a 50S ribosomal stalk component involved in interaction with GTP-bound translation factors.
Pfam hits: Ribosomal_L12_N (PF16320.11, residues 4–51) and Ribosomal_L12 (PF00542.25, residues 56–122).
Sequence-derived estimates: 12,567.3 Da; theoretical pI 4.676; GRAVY 0.1279; instability index 24.01.
